3.a) How N, cycle maintain proper functioning of the ecosystem? 2 | ]

Ans. Nitrogen cycle
Nitrogen cycle is that biogeochemical cycle through which the movement of nitrogen occurs
etween biotic (living) and abiotic (lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere) components of
the ecosystem.

Process of Nitrogen Cycle consists of the following steps ..

1. Nitrogen fixation: Nitrogen from the atmosphere is converted into ammonia and
other nitrogeneous compound by certain bacterial species like Rhizobium,
Azotobacter, etc. and by other natural phenomena.

1. Assimilation: Nitrogen in the form of nitrite ions, nitrate ions or ammonium ions
enters in the plant and animal body.

2. Ammonification: After the death of plants and animals nitrogen present in organic
matter converts to ammonium compounds by ammonifying bacteria,

3. Nitrification: Nitrites and nitrate salts are formed by the oxidation of ammonia with
the help of Nitrosomonas bacteria species.

4. Denitrification: Inorganic N, is produced from nitrate /nitrite salts by denitrifying
bacteriaand released into the atmosphere

Ans. Drought: A drought is a natural phenomenonn of prolonged shortages in the water
supply, whether atmospheric, surface water or ground water.
